correctness.rationale: The sign-preserving velocity-reset telegraph process has an exact first-reset Green–Kubo identity. Generator balances give the linear benchmark. The residual Green–Kubo term differs by only \(O(r^{-6})\); the two leading effects sum to \(-6b\Sigma^4/(\lambda r^5)\). The exact-rational stationary-moment and cubic Poisson-resolvent checker passed 576 finite checks. The analytic proof, not these checks, supports the infinite-rate result.

The precise first rheology-sensitive \(r^{-5}\) coefficient identifies a natural macroscopic transport signature and fixes which medium diffuses faster for sufficiently rapid resets.
